result.summary: A simplified invoice (Fatura Simplificada) from Maria da Glória Cabeleireiros Lda., a hair salon at Centro Comercial Primavera, Coimbra, Portugal (NIF 121653897). Dated 2020-11-04 11:16 (document FS A/42402), it lists two services — Brushing Medio (€10.00) and Lavagem (€2.20) — with 23% IVA (VAT €2.28 on a base of €9.92), for a total of €12.20 EUR paid in cash (DINHEIRO). It was processed by certified Sage software (nº 2648/AT) and notes it does not constitute a transport document under Decree-Law nº 147/2003.

A thermal-printed credit note (Nota de Crédito) from Zara Home (Portugal), issued at the Forum Coimbra store (Loja 1718) on 10-11-2020 at 17:14. It credits 99,99€ for the return (Motivo: Devolução) of a rug (TAPETE, item 4631802940089), settled as an exchange of goods (Permuta de bens), and references the original sales document FS 001715012020/014205. The document includes the company's Portuguese registration details (NIF 506648117) and a certified billing program reference (2742/AT).

A simplified invoice (Fatura Simplificada) from Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Tiger Portugal, SA at Fórum Coimbra, printed with the transaction date 2021-05-06 11:48. It covers one item, a foldable black bag (BAG FOLDABEL BLACK W), at a total of 3.00 EUR including 23% VAT (0.56 EUR on a base of 2.44 EUR), paid by Multibanco. The receipt notes exchanges only with an invoice within 30 days, no returns accepted, and states it was processed by a certified tax program (nº 2648/AT - Sage) and does not constitute a transport document.
